race.comment: DRIALLE (1) is the horse to beat after a decisive Kilcoy win, where he was sent out favourite and beat Vermilion Kirin by just over three lengths. The 3kg claim helps with 64kg, William Galloway has won two from three on him, and his record around 1400m gives the top pick a solid platform. STANDLEE (4) looks the main danger, coming off a Class 4 third at Gold Coast after winning at Warwick from Hang Out, and he has already beaten DRIALLE this campaign. PRETTY RHO (12) is third-up and has opened this campaign with a Morven BM65 win and a Stanthorpe placing, though she rises out of picnic company and profiles more as a durable place threat than a dominant winning chance. SNUGG (5) hit the line well when third last start at Ipswich over 1680m. Looks tough to stop again.
